findings.claim: ASML 在 Q3 2026 財報表示，現行 2027 與 2028 供給計畫仍無法完全滿足客戶需求
findings.excerpt: With such strong visibility and an order book momentum that continues to increase quarter on quarter this year, we now expect that our supply as currently planned for both 2027 and 2028 will not fully meet the demand of our customers.

findings.claim: ASML 已規劃 2027 年低 NA EUV 與 DUV 浸潤式產能較 2026 增 30%，並研究 2028 年超過 30% 的擴產
findings.excerpt: investigating ways to increase capacity for 2028 beyond the 30% increase we previously communicated

findings.claim: 部分客戶有意下 2029、2030 年訂單；有分析提醒其中部分可能是保留產能行為而非確定訂單
findings.excerpt: some customers are expressing an interest in placing orders with us for 2029 and even 2030
Q4 guidance is sales of €14.2bn to €15.2bn with a gross margin around 57%. Full-year 2026 sales are now seen at €44bn to €45bn, with a margin around 56%

findings.claim: SEMI 2025 年底預測設備總銷售 2027 年達 $156bn（2026 年 $145bn），WFE 2027 年 $135.2bn；中國銷售預期自 2026 起逐步下滑（該預測非 2026 年更新版）
記憶體端：SK Hynix 約 $38bn 新廠 M17 第一座無塵室最早 2028 年 12 月開出，Micron 稱 2027、2028 年需求仍超過供給；另有 Silicon Motion 觀點認為 DRAM 自 2027 下半年新大廠量產後可望緩解（各家說法不一，二手彙整，日期未標）
findings.source: Webull 'SK Hynix Approved $38 Billion of New Memory Fabs That Won't Produce a Chip Before December 2028'
findings.excerpt: In calendar 2027 as well as 2028, we see demand exceeding supply.

note: 最後一條 as_of 為估計（搜尋結果 Taipei Times 2026/07/11 同批），原文日期未能確認；SEMI 無 2026 年更新版；未取得 Q3 2026 backlog 數字；第4次搜尋未使用
